draft_assertions.expected: Under declared Databento trade semantics, T/B size 3 contributes buy=3, T/A size 2 sell=2, T/N size 4 unknown=4; total=9, signed=1. A/B book-side meanings remain separate. N is not an iceberg label.

A valid T without F_LAST remains eligible. Decode combined flags 132 and 168 bitwise using the exact provider/schema/version; unresolved publisher-specific bits retain raw evidence and explicit uncertainty. Do not impose MBO-only F_LAST buffering on normalized MBP-1.

Two distinct legitimate transactions sharing timestamp, price and size remain two; a repeated acquisition of one original is idempotent. Timestamp-price dedup is rejected; source ownership and multiplicity determine evidence.

Two standalone and one potentially embedded matching print retain an uncertain match set; do not concatenate into three confirmed executions or force one-to-one identity. Report matched/unmatched counts and volumes by condition and comparable cohort.

Insert buy size 3 at price 100: total=3, signed=3, notional=300. A later known revision to sell size 2 at price 101 changes state to total=2, signed=-2, notional=202; deltas -1,-5,-98. Duplicate revision changes nothing. Cancel removes remaining mass once. Earlier decision views stay unchanged.

Correction received before its referenced original is explicitly unresolved/pending, never an invented fresh trade; resolve once when ownership is available under a declared causal policy. Orphan and conflicting lineage remain visible.

Same sequence across different instruments/channels/publishers or session resets is not globally unique. Original transaction, receipt revision and correction IDs remain separate; raw contract identity survives continuous-symbol mappings.

Versioned provider/date condition rules label auction, cancel/correct and spread transactions. Unknown conditions quarantine directional use and retain provenance. Invalid zero/negative outright sizes are rejected; spread units cannot silently become outright quantity. No blind condition removal.

Repeated BBO snapshot is state evidence, not fresh trade flow. Trade plus later book update cannot subtract the trade twice; MBP-1 does not expose off-touch depth, participant identity, or queue ownership.

Deleting every future suffix, delaying corrections, and reopening before/after consumer commit preserves earlier event-derived views and exactly-once reducer effects under declared acknowledgement semantics. Actual availability, not origin time, releases revisions.

Theta exchange/bid_exchange/ask_exchange, sequence, Databento publisher_id/instrument_id/side must not populate customer/dealer identity. Trade Outline proposal is aggregate origin/open-close by venue, not individual-firm identity and not an acquired feed.

Vendor-reported sign remains the baseline; OPRA at-quote/inside-spread inference is separately tagged O03 output. Stale/crossed/locked quotes, bundles, multi-leg uncertainty and invalid conditions remain explicit. Next-day OI cannot retrospectively be an intraday opening/closing observation.
Manifest/file counts and small first-record audit samples do not prove complete record quality, no gaps, source equality or receipt latency; record exact admitted cohort and unresolved scope.
Futures-option definitions/statistics/trades/bars do not establish an observed synchronized quote surface or universal aggressor availability; unsupported fields remain absent.
Earlier NQ trades may be derived only from eligible MBP-1 actions with overlap reconciliation. Do not invent complete ES book, pre-2017 RTY history, or standalone NQ trades back to 2020.
Single-venue ETF bars and limited reference pulls retain coverage and are not additive flow; absent intraday cash spot cannot be replaced by an unlabeled observed spot series.
Keep seven roots and field/expiry/strike/time coverage distinct; full daily chains do not imply full intraday chains. Overlapping legacy/surface selections are reconciled, not blindly added.
Daily cash/VX and publication/revision-dependent context do not become contemporaneous intraday observations. Scenario repricing does not count as new options flow.
Roll map/continuous symbol is not proof of as-of roll choice or native event identity; raw contract joins remain auditable and backadjusted values are not executable prices.
MBP-10 and MBO unavailable capabilities stay disabled. MBP-10 means ten price levels, not necessarily ten ticks; N or unchanged displayed size does not establish hidden size.

Preserve event, source-record, provider receipt, strategy receipt and publication clocks. QuantPad ms/ns and Theta stored UTC-ns with ms precision are explicit; do not relocalize UTC or invent missing sequence/receipt columns.
Old pull-list/queued status is history, not current availability or authorization. Reuse existing audited evidence and do not label already acquired trade_quote as absent solely from old prose.

Bounded partition processing measures actual resource use. Historical host CPU/RAM and shared filesystem capacity are not dedicated cgroup capacity; missing historical hardware transcript remains missing.

Retain all eligible/rejected/untraded candidate observations and freeze hypotheses before outcomes; winner/loser comparisons and repeated same-sample refinement cannot certify edge. Numerical data and journaling alone are insufficient.

Reject deterministic next-candle certainty without rejecting conditional single-event probability models; evaluate distributions on chronology and supported cohorts. No predictive run is authorized here.

Trend/history-relative/macro feature families are retained as candidates; C-score formula is unavailable and must not be invented. Numeric inputs do not by themselves establish objectivity, comparability or edge.

Retain cycle/leverage/borrowing/housing/valuation/capex/rate families for vintage-audited research; reject undated no-bubble verdict and universal all-conditions necessity. No current-market diagnosis or empirical bubble result is supplied.

Source heading says two wins but mechanics escalates after first win. Original-capital arithmetic +3 then +12 gives +15, or +3 minus4 gives -1, before fees; current-capital percentages differ. Exposure escalation creates no edge; retain benchmark only, no one-mini escalation. 100 trades and simulated max loss do not guarantee safety.

missing_dependencies.dependency: Original DEN C-score formula and empirical calculations/datasets for bubble and streak claims
missing_dependencies.effect: Cannot reproduce undocumented scores or certify those claims; not required to implement event identity.
Cannot revalidate historical resource measurements; current actual bounded telemetry must be distinct.

missing_dependencies.dependency: Complete native cohort-specific provider/schema/date condition and flag certification plus raw/corrected overlap reconciliation
missing_dependencies.effect: Required before claiming broad native event eligibility or vendor equality; this preparation reads no market records.

missing_dependencies.dependency: Actual strategy receipt streams and full downstream consumer parity/integration/economic evidence
missing_dependencies.effect: Required for live latency and complete phase claims; not supplied by inventory metadata or synthetic engineering.

missing_dependencies.dependency: Participant/dealer identity and acquired Trade Outline origin/open-close data
missing_dependencies.effect: Not present in cited current schemas. No purchase or new feed dependency is imposed on baseline F05; optional product coverage/cost/latency facts remain unverified here.

missing_dependencies.dependency: Off-touch depth/MBO order identity and unsupported contemporaneous intraday cash/option-quote fields
missing_dependencies.effect: Those capabilities stay unavailable where inventory does not support them; MBP-1 proxies cannot substitute silently.

preserved_rejected_clauses: Timestamp-price-only deduplication; one-to-one matching without multiplicity/lineage evidence.
Unknown side N or unchanged BBO size as iceberg/participant identity evidence.
MBO-only event buffering and mandatory F_LAST applied to MBP-1 trade inclusion.
One-for-one Theta/Databento completeness, blind trade-condition removal, and future OI as contemporaneous opening/closing truth.
Ten levels equated to ten ticks; universal depth irrelevance or negligible execution cost based solely on hold horizon; 750 sessions proving model adequacy/memorization.
Venue/contract/sequence/aggressor fields interpreted as dealer/customer identity.
Numerical inputs establish edge/objectivity; repeated same-outcome refinement proves improvement; certainty rejection excludes conditional probabilities.
Undated bubble verdict and universal all-bubble-conditions claim.

Asymmetric risk escalation creates edge; inconsistent two-win activation; fee-free original-capital arithmetic treated as current-capital truth; 100-trade/Monte-Carlo guarantee and contract escalation.
